name: Graph3CE
summary: A 3D graphing calculator: plot up to six surfaces and rotate them.
description:
Plots z as a function of x and y, up to six equations at a time, and lets you turn the result around to look at it.

[y=] enters equations, [window] sets the extents and how dense the mesh is, [zoom] zooms, [trace] traces and [graph] draws. [2nd] [mode] leaves, and your settings and equations are still there next time.

A malformed equation is marked with two red exclamation marks when you try to graph it rather than failing quietly. XSteps and YSteps control the contour lines in each direction: the larger they are the more accurate the mesh and the slower it is to rotate.

The author calls this a gold release — believed stable, but it may crash the calculator and force a restart.
author: Christopher "Kerm Martian" Mitchell

uninstall.text: Graph3CE saves your equations and window settings itself, in a file it made rather than one this installed. That has been left alone, so putting it back finds your work where you left it.
